author: TeIq
content:
Implementation complete (issue #60).

Crate: polaris-publish-did-service (new workspace member).

Library surface (src/lib.rs):
- build_did_web_document(handle, did_pds_endpoint, signing_pubkey_did, service_url) -> Result<serde_json::Value, BuildError>
- validate_did_document(doc, expected_service_url, expected_signing_pubkey_did) -> Result<(), ValidationError>
- Typed error enums (thiserror). 9 unit tests covering happy path + negative cases.

Binary surface (src/main.rs): clap CLI with --account, --service-url, --signing-key, --did-method=plc|web. did:web emits .well-known/did.json JSON to stdout; did:plc walks the proto-blue PLC operation triad (request_plc_operation_signature -> emailed token via stdin/--token/POLARIS_PLC_TOKEN -> sign_plc_operation -> submit_plc_operation) using generated types only. Tracing routed to stderr.

Evidence floor (all pass): build, clippy -D warnings, fmt --check, 16 tests, --help documents flag values, xtask check-frontend-boundary 0 violations.

Forbidden patterns: no unwrap/expect outside cfg(test), no hand-rolled PLC JSON, no secrets in argv, no commits.
